title: Asian Games: PH triathlon team wraps up campaign on proud note

blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine national triathlon squad ended its Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 stint with a ninth-place finish in the mixed relay event on Monday at Gamagori City Triathlon Venue. The quartet of Raven Alcoseba, Kim Mangrobang, Fer Casares, and Andrew Kim Remolino clocked in at 1:32:56, ahead of Singapore (10th), Macao (11th), and Thailand (12th). “I think it was really good fun for everyone.
